ops.statement: A commander idle_notification does not distinguish done from stalled. Gate classification on artifact completeness: commit on branch AND open PR both present -> done; otherwise -> stalled (regardless of idle reason). Recovery for a stall = SendMessage return-and-continue with the same agent; do NOT kill and relaunch (idle/available means context is intact; two-agents-in-worktree risk otherwise).
